title: Bass Haven

services.name: Boat Rentals
services.desc: Generally boats 22ft and under are able to launch. Water levels may change this. We can assist in the decision to help with the boat launch for safe operation. Access our useful map of Lake St. Clair and surrounding waterways, to help you in finding the perfect spot for your next

services.name: Ice Fishing
services.desc: brings many anglers to the Mitchell’s Bay area this time of year. Whether you are walking or have an ATV/snowmobile, you are never to far away from the fish. If conditions allow it, we allow people to access the lake via our boat launch, to get on the lake. Ice thickness will determine whether the access will only be for people walking, or if ATV/snowmobiles will be allowed. For a small parking fee, anglers and families can enjoy a great day on the “Hard Water”. Access our useful map of Lake St. Clair and surrounding waterways, to help you in finding the perfect spot for your next

blurb: Bass Haven offers fishing, hunting, ice fishing, boat launching, boat rentals, tackle shop, campground, and cottage rentals. It is a family operated outfitter established over 40 years ago. The location is on Lake St. Clair at Mitchell's Bay, Ontario, Canada.

quotes.text: Did some ice fishing out of bass haven. The staff was knowledgeable and helped us get on the fish. They also had a large assortment of tackle and snacks!
Great customer service, picked up my fishing license there.
I have been fishing here for about 55 years...love it!!!
